name: Allowed Text Format Field Widget
description: Field widget for formatted long-text fields that restricts which text formats are offered in the format selector.
provides_plugin_types: FieldWidget: allowed_text_format_field_widget (Plugin/Field/FieldWidget/AllowedTextFormatFieldWidget) — extends core TextareaWidget, for text_long fields
project_description:
This module provides a field widget "Allowed Text Format" that allows to restrict the list of

editor formats for a formatted text field.

 The difference with a similar module "Allowed Text Format" is the availability

to choose different restrictions according to form display type for a field.

 The other module "Allowed Text Format" provide restriction on field. So you can not

define different text format restrictions according to form display types.

 That's why we created this module that provide more flexibility and reusability.

 How to ?

 
 Go to the form display page of the entity for wich you need the widget 
 Change the widget type for the field you want to restrict, and select "Allowed format" 
 Configure widget options by choosing the formats you need/want for your field
